source.title: WCA Regulations - August 2023
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Regulations Committee would like to inform you about the new version of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect on **August 1st, 2023**.

You can review all changes in [this comparison on GitHub](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2023-02-01...official-2023-08-01). You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulation and Guidelines, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are marked red.

Below is a *summary* of the major changes in the new version of the Regulations and the Guidelines.

- 5b5f and additional Visual Guide ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/af0c530b8e3553e64ece003d19dc540734d2c012))
- Add the WCA Scramble Accountability Policy ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/c0438c65dbe1970e1b0fa1989f97bbd3fb567158))
- Make A7c2 more lenient ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/6169a1504def70326c3cde25c2addb4df3ff3ab3))
- Change “interact” to “use” in 2i ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/6c610bb631ac2188568ed4bd437f19621002f362))
- Add an exception to A5a ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/f3dc1ddd9a6a01cb0f306ee33143f7bd5b760c27))

translation.title: WCA 竞赛规则更新（2023 年 8 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会在此通知，新版《WCA 竞赛规则与指南》将于 **2023 年 8 月 1 日**生效。

所有改动可在 [GitHub 版本对比](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2023-02-01...official-2023-08-01)中查看。点击“Files changed”即可查看规则与指南的完整文件，其中新增和修改的内容标为绿色，删除的内容标为红色。

以下是新版规则与指南主要改动的*概要*。

- 修改规则 5b5f，并补充图示指南（[提交记录](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/af0c530b8e3553e64ece003d19dc540734d2c012)）
- 加入《WCA 打乱问责政策》（[提交记录](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/c0438c65dbe1970e1b0fa1989f97bbd3fb567158)）
- 放宽规则 A7c2（[提交记录](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/6169a1504def70326c3cde25c2addb4df3ff3ab3)）
- 将规则 2i 中的“interact”（交互）改为“use”（使用）（[提交记录](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/6c610bb631ac2188568ed4bd437f19621002f362)）
- 为规则 A5a 增加一项例外（[提交记录](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/f3dc1ddd9a6a01cb0f306ee33143f7bd5b760c27)）
